claims_upsert.scope: Small-grid numerical verification; not a proof of every production-scale run.
claims_upsert.statement: The periodic RTE operator and native FGMRES evaluator pass independent dense-matrix and residual checks on small grids.
The current RTE ablation trains a new model for each fixed coefficient medium and evaluates held-out sources, so it does not establish cross-medium coefficient generalization.
The structured moment models and moment U-Net restrict learned corrections to a fixed retained angular Fourier subspace Q_K.
The RTE learned U-Net uses circular padding for ordinary convolutions but zero-boundary transposed-convolution and resize operations, producing a measurable learned-correction shift defect.

claims_upsert.scope: Single-seed size-16 control; causal direction, not a universal scaling law.
claims_upsert.statement: In a matched small mixed control, width 32 lowered sampled loss but did not improve held-out one-step residual and worsened capped FGMRES relative to width 16.
A lower sampled training objective is not equivalent to lower held-out one-step error or better FGMRES because the sampled residual distribution and solver Krylov directions differ.
The Helmholtz training loop varies coefficient media across batches and uses fresh random right-hand sides, unlike the current per-medium RTE ablations.

decisions_append: Treat the current RTE learned method as a structure-preserving compression/adaptation hypothesis, not as a demonstrated replacement for TSA4.
Do not spend the next experiment budget on width-only scaling before fixing periodic transfer and the angular candidate-space restriction.
next_actions: Implement periodic transfer and rerun the shift-defect test.
Implement K_candidate > K_solve learned angular R/P with scalar preservation.
Create a small coefficient-ensemble training/evaluation split.
Use held-out FGMRES and time-to-tolerance for checkpoint selection.

obligations_upsert.text: Replace zero-boundary decoder transfer by periodic, preferably phase-aware, restriction and prolongation and rerun the symmetry test.
Implement K_candidate greater than K_solve with bounded learned restriction/prolongation and exact scalar-mode preservation.
Train on randomized coefficient fields and test on held-out media, sources, and resolutions.
Use teacher imitation, diverse later residuals, and held-out FGMRES/time-to-tolerance checkpointing.
Compare learned, TSA2, and TSA4 at equal base calls and equal wall time including setup and network overhead.

rejected_paths_upsert.reason: Dense operator, exact splitting, direct solve, and FGMRES checks do not support an operator implementation bug as the primary explanation.
The width control lowers training loss without improving held-out one-step or capped FGMRES, so increasing width alone is not a sufficient fix.

delta.stage_summary: Completed a source-pinned audit of the Helmholtz/RTE learned-preconditioner project. The operator and FGMRES paths pass small independent checks. The strongest causal bottlenecks are sampled-loss versus Krylov mismatch, fixed angular-subspace restriction, full-angular channel compression, and non-periodic U-Net decoder transfer. Width and zero-init effects are real but secondary.

payload.task: Record the completed Helmholtz/RTE code and mathematics audit with explicit numerical evidence, causal bottleneck ranking, and next falsification experiments.
